WHEN `screenshot` succeeds THEN the result includes `origin {x,y}` (physical px), `scale` and `captureMethod` (plus `windowRect` for handle captures), and mapping a known element's image-space center with `origin + px / scale` lands within 2 px of its UIA bbox center.
WHEN `screenshot(handle)` falls through to the `desktop` method while another window covers the target THEN the result has `occluded: true` (or fails with `Occluded`, as tools.md decides).
WHEN `launch_app` runs while a window of the same process already exists THEN the returned handle was not in the pre-launch window set and `isNew: true`, or the call fails with `Timeout`.
WHEN a coordinate `click`, `scroll` or `drag` is given `handle` and another window holds the foreground after focusing THEN it fails with `FocusFailed` and sends no input.

WHEN `screenshot` gets an `outputPath` inside the configured output root THEN it writes the PNG and returns path, `sha256` and size without base64; WHEN the path is outside the root THEN it fails with `InvalidArgument` and writes nothing.
WHEN `screenshot` succeeds THEN the result includes a perceptual hash of the frame, and two captures of an unchanged window give hashes within the documented distance.
WHEN `scroll` completes THEN the result reports `changed` (frame hash before vs. after), and tools.md documents what one unit of `amount` means on each path.
WHEN `wait_for region-stable` watches a region that keeps changing THEN it fails with `Timeout` after `timeoutMs`; WHEN the region is unchanged for `settleMs` THEN it returns `ok: true`.

WHEN an input tool targets a protected window (the server's host window or a configured `protectedWindows` entry) without `allowSelf: true` THEN it fails with the typed error tools.md assigns and sends no input.
WHEN `list_windows` returns THEN every window has `rect`, `monitor`, `dpi` and `isCloaked`.

WHEN tools.md, errors.md and security.md are read THEN they document every field, parameter and error code named in AC-1…AC-11, the `screenshot` region schema drift is resolved, and an ADR records what was accepted, changed or deferred.

acceptance.text: type_text with a ref whose element cannot take focus returns FocusFailed and sends no input (test with a non-focusable element)
ValuePattern path replaces the value by default; append is an explicit option; covered by a test
submit is skipped and reported as submitted:false when focus is not on the target
docs/tools.md documents the new defaults

body:
Observed 2026-11-22 driving DxO PhotoLab 10.3.2 (crow-carousel session, strix):
- type_text keyboard branch: when Focus() fails and the bbox is empty, it still sends SelectAll() (Ctrl+A) and the text to whatever has focus. In PhotoLab, Ctrl+A selected every filmstrip image, so the following edits (local masks) were applied to four photos.
- submit calls a global SendEnter() after Focus() even when focus was not confirmed; in PhotoLab the Enter moved the selection to the next image.
- ValuePattern branch without clearFirst writes old + text (append): a mask named "AI mask" became "AI maskSubject".
- A stray keystroke also triggered PhotoLab's "Export to disk".

Proposal: confirm HasKeyboardFocus on the target (or a descendant) before SelectAll, typing, Enter (type_text, hotkey, press_key with a ref); otherwise fail with FocusFailed and send nothing (explicit allowUnfocused opt-out). ValuePattern path defaults to replace (append opt-in) and never sends Ctrl+A. submit only after re-confirming focus, else submitted:false.
title: Keyboard safety: never send keys to an unverified focus

acceptance.text: move_pointer (or hover) tool exists and is listed in docs/tools.md
set_value on a RangeValue slider that rejects SetValue falls back to a pointer action and reports the achieved value
toggle accepts state on/off and is idempotent
actions accept an optional expectation and return ExpectationFailed on mismatch
screenshot always returns origin and scale
inspect_at returns a result for elements without AutomationId

body:
Gaps hit 2026-11-22 automating DxO PhotoLab 10.3.2:
1. No pointer-move/hover tool: PhotoLab's brush option bar (Size/Feather/Flow/Opacity) only exists while the pointer is over the viewer.
2. set_value on WPF RangeValue sliders throws "Operation is not valid due to the current state of the object" with no fallback (drag/click track to computed position + readback).
3. Tool buttons are toggles; click switched an active tool off. toggle should accept state on|off and return before/after.
4. Generic post-condition guard: optional expect block on actions (e.g. SelectedImages text must still match "^\d+ images$"); on mismatch return ExpectationFailed.
5. Window identity by pid/processName + title pattern, re-resolved on WindowGone (PhotoLab recreates its main window).
6. Full-screen screenshot result lacks origin/scale; document that region* are physical pixels.
7. inspect_at throws InternalError on unsupported AutomationId [#30011]; omit the field instead.
8. scroll by ref should use ScrollPattern.SetScrollPercent (nested ScrollViewers made "scroll to top" unreliable).
title: Agent ergonomics: hover, idempotent toggle, RangeValue fallback, action expectations
